rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for a paternal grandmother, especially when addressing her or speaking familiarly.

example.jyutping: aa3 maa4 nei5 sik6 zo2 faan6 mei6 aa3

rows.note: Use this for a maternal grandmother; it is also a familiar form of address for her.

example.english: Grandma, I’ll come visit you later.
example.traditional: 婆婆，我陣間過嚟探你呀。
example.jyutping: po4 po4 ngo5 zan6 gaan1 gwo3 lai4 taam3 nei5 aa3
